The university attended by Stewart Patridge—**the University of Mississippi (Ole Miss)**—was first integrated by **James Meredith**.  

Meredith became the first African‑American student admitted to Ole Miss in 1962 after a federal court order, and his enrollment triggered the infamous Ole Miss riot of 1962.  His entry marked the first time a black student had been allowed to enroll at the university.  

> “James Meredith… became, in 1962, the first African‑American student admitted to the racially segregated University of Mississippi…” – *Wikipedia*, James Meredith article.
